status: industry_unit_selected; earlier alternatives remain research history
active_protocol_note: The active plan, paper and config are now v4.2. The candidate arrays below preserve earlier research history; the v4.2 config and sector corpus are authoritative.
user_direction: Use a recent period rather than the full historical span.

period_candidates.estimation_history: Frozen retrospective indexing: for each reference month 2024-01 through 2025-12, use exactly the preceding 60 observation months. Data are currently revised values, not verified historical publication-time availability.

source_roles.https://arxiv.org/html/2605.27887v6: Appendix B.2 uses 2024-2025 as its held-out QA test period; this is not the same as its pipeline evaluation period.
source_roles.https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full: 60-month estimation-length precedent; not a prescription of our proposed evaluation dates.

period_candidates.provenance: LIBERA adaptation combining separately sourced choices
period_candidates.limitations: Recent evaluation still requires trailing estimation history. FF12 constituents still change. A separate 24-window, 72-case numerical control is now prepared in data/institutional_recent; it is not the documentary main task.

period_candidates.provenance: direct paper candidate; not downloaded or adopted
period_candidates.limitations: A single short market window, point-in-time changing membership, and no proof of general financial performance. Public dataset release, licensing, manifest, necessary fields, source versions and model knowledge-cutoff implications must be audited before use. Paper risk-profile presets are research assumptions, not measured preferences of actual funds.

risk_recommendation.input: Keep qualitative preferences as documented prose; preserve explicit numeric constraints with their denominator and exceptions. Mark absent information as not stated.
risk_recommendation.evaluation: Quantitatively measure mandate compliance and portfolio characteristics without inventing a prose-to-gamma mapping.
risk_recommendation.gamma_role: The existing paper-derived gamma 1/3/5 may remain a separate hypothetical numerical task, not a calibration of real institutions.
risk_recommendation.scope_caution: All-equity industry allocation limits the ability to express overall risk preference through stocks versus bonds or cash.

document_recommendation.unit: Identify the issuing institution and responsible organizational unit. Use a named fund/share class only for fund documents; distinguish a house research view from a fund mandate.
document_recommendation.official_data_not_paper: Regulatory and fund documents supply empirical mandate facts. Academic papers support task/evaluation design; they do not validate invented fund parameter values.
document_recommendation.candidate_fact: Vanguard PRIMECAP summary prospectus dated 2026-01-28: long-term capital appreciation; may invest up to 25% of assets in foreign securities. The cap is not a target weight or an industry allocation rule.
document_recommendation.version_gate: Check filing availability, supplement chain and applicability at each decision date before selecting any packet. Never combine 2026 mandates with historical decisions as if they were then available.
document_recommendation.scope_gate: FF12 alone does not expose issuer nationality, currency, market capitalization, growth/value or blue-chip eligibility. Unsupported constraints cannot be scored from industry returns alone.

evaluation_candidates.name: asset validity
evaluation_candidates.definition: Exists at the decision time, permitted by the supplied universe and mandate; for FF12 validate industry identifiers rather than invented stock-level holdings.

evaluation_candidates.name: mandate extraction and evidence
evaluation_candidates.definition: Correct objectives, numeric values, denominators, exceptions and source support against an independently reviewed evaluator-only annotation.

evaluation_candidates.name: constraint adherence
evaluation_candidates.definition: Record each constraint's violation separately; retain proposed weights before any deterministic repair.

evaluation_candidates.name: allocation tendency
evaluation_candidates.definition: Test only document-supported exposures or prespecified, justified responses to a changed mandate while holding common market evidence fixed. No unsupported sector direction inferred from a risk label.

evaluation_candidates.name: numeric distance
evaluation_candidates.definition: Use continuous distance where an independent mathematical reference exists. Holdings similarity measures reproduction, not uniquely correct strategy. Do not invent a pass tolerance after viewing main outcomes.

evaluation_candidates.name: institutional differentiation
evaluation_candidates.definition: Assess whether justified institution-specific responses survive across workflows; similarity alone is neither failure nor success, and difference alone is not proof of quality.

evaluation_freeze_recommendation.pilot: Allow rubric, parser and reporting refinements on declared exploratory cases.
evaluation_freeze_recommendation.main: Freeze primary metrics, expected directions where justified, comparison references, missing/invalid rules and any thresholds before observing held-out main responses. Pilot-tuned cases cannot silently become confirmatory evidence.
evaluation_freeze_recommendation.post_main: Additional outcome-informed metrics may be reported explicitly as exploratory.
evaluation_freeze_recommendation.metrics_locator: Appendix F.3 separates reference agreement, exposure compliance and financial outcomes.

user_selected_unit: industry/sector allocation, conditional on construct validity; retained with documentary task requirements

selected_main.scope: Documentary sector-judgment case study; not actual fund mandate or risk-preference replication
